newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Winnerway to pay lower corporate tax.
newsitem.headline: Winnerway to pay lower corporate tax.

text.p: Guangdong-based Dongguan Winnerway Industrial Zone Co Ltd said on Thursday the local government had cut its corporate income tax to 15 percent from 33 percent.
The Dongguan city government granted Winnerway the tax reduction because it is a public company, the firm said in a notice published in the Shenzhen-based newspaper.
Most listed Chinese firms are assessed at 15 percent, while other companies are taxed at 33 percent.

Winnerway said the preferential treatment would date back to 1994 when it became a listed enterprise, and the city government would rebate it a combined 61.74 million yuan for the past two years and the first half of 1996.
Trading in Winnerway's A shares was suspended on Thursday morning pending the announcement.
In an interim report, Winnerway said it had chalked up net earnings of 47.57 million yuan in the first half of 1996, compared with 46.40 million yuan a year earlier.
Winnerway, which operates an industrial development zone in Dongguan, had reported net earnings of 89.48 million yuan for 1995, slightly above the previous year's 89.23 million yuan.
